messages.subject: Error in fit(plm)
parts:
Hi,

when running this code chunk from the Vignette for SNP6.0 analysis:

if (length(findUnitsTodo(plm)) > 0) {
  # Fit CN probes quickly (~5-10s/array + some overhead)
  units <- fitCnProbes(plm, verbose=verbose)
  str(units)
  # int [1:945826] 935590 935591 935592 935593 935594 935595 ...
 
  # Fit remaining units, i.e. SNPs (~5-10min/array)
  units <- fit(plm, verbose=verbose)
  str(units)
}

I get the following error:

20120112 16:45:44|      Reading probe intensities from 56 arrays...done
Error in list(`#4: fit(plm, verbose = verbose)` = <environment>, `#4: fit.ProbeLevelModel(plm, verbose = verbose)` = <environment>,  :
 
[2012-01-12 16:45:44] Exception: Internal error: The read units does not have 4 groups: 2
  at throw(Exception(...))
  at throw.default("Internal error: The read units does not have ", nbrOfGroups,
  at throw("Internal error: The read units does not have ", nbrOfGroups, " group
  at #4: fit.ProbeLevelModel(plm, verbose = verbose)
  at #4: fit(plm, verbose = verbose)
20120112 16:45:44|     Fitting chunk #1 of 1 of 'genotyping' units (code=2) with 4 groups/6+6+6+6 cells...done
20120112 16:45:44|    Unit dimension #3 (4 groups/6+6+6+6 cells) of 5...done
20120112 16:45:44|   Fitting the model by unit dimensions (at least for the large classes)...done
20120112 16:45:44|  Unit type #2 ('genotyping') of 2...done
20120112 16:45:44| Fitting AvgCnPlm for each unit type separately...done
20120112 16:45:44|Fitting model of class AvgCnPlm...done

The error occurs on two independent data sets, so I guess it has something to do with the annotation files or with my version of aroma.

Greetings,
Christian
